en: Added this build update section to the existing internal demo information page. You can reopen the same page from the Lio menu.
Improved the display of greetings and sent messages while keeping larger text sizes and light and dark appearances.
Long-press the greeting to copy it in full. Sent messages keep native selection and copying of part of the text.
zh: 现有内部演示说明中新增本版更新，可从 Lio 菜单重新打开同一页面。
改善开场白和已发消息的文字显示，保留完整内容、大字号和浅深色外观。
开场白可长按复制整段，已发消息继续支持选择一个词或一段文字复制。

en: Compared with build 43, this build adds offline update information and improves conversation text display and copying.
It does not fix trip planning or change the conversation experience enabled by default for everyday accounts.
zh: 与构建 43 相比，这一版新增离线更新说明，并改善对话文字显示和复制操作。
规划功能没有因此修好，日常账号的默认对话方式也没有改变。

en: In the Lio menu, open Internal demo information and check the current and previous build updates.
Switch between light and dark appearances, increase the system text size, and check that existing messages remain readable and complete.
Copy the full greeting, then select and copy one word from a sent message. Paste into the input field to check it without sending.
Leave an unsent draft, put the app in the background, and return. Check that the same conversation and draft remain.
zh: 从 Lio 菜单打开内部演示说明，查看本版和上一版更新。
切换浅色和深色，并调大系统文字，查看已有对话是否清楚、完整。
复制整段开场白，再从已发消息中选一个词复制，粘到输入框核对，先不要发送。
留下一段未发送文字，切到后台再返回，查看是否仍是同一对话和草稿。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Trip planning is still being fixed; we do not recommend testing it yet.
The complete planning, saving, editing, undo, and remembering-preferences journey has not passed this round of live verification. Please hold off on that acceptance test.
The new segmented replies, multiple-choice questions, and preference tags remain limited to designated testing and are not enabled by default for everyday accounts.
zh: 规划功能仍在修复，暂不建议测试规划。
规划、保存、修改、撤销及记住偏好的完整流程尚未完成本轮真实验证，请暂不进行这组验收。
新版分段、多选和画像交互目前仅供指定测试使用，未向日常账号默认开启。

en: The Hong Kong online service is using source 7750871.
Failure diagnostics are live; this server update does not require an app update.
Basic questions have not passed every check; diagnostics do not mean planning is fixed.
zh: 香港在线服务来源为 7750871。
失败诊断已上线，这项在线更新不需要更新应用。
基础问答尚未全部通过，新增诊断不代表规划已经修复。

en: Improved the display of trip detail titles, retaining complete titles and larger text sizes.
zh: 改善行程详情标题的显示，保留完整标题和大字号。

en: Compared with build 42, build 43 focused on trip detail title display. Trip planning was not considered fixed.
zh: 与构建 42 相比，构建 43 主要调整行程详情标题显示，未宣告规划功能修复。

en: Open an existing trip and inspect its title in light and dark appearances.
Increase the system text size and check that the complete title remains available.
zh: 打开已有行程，在浅色和深色下查看标题。
调大系统文字，查看是否仍能读到完整标题。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Trip planning was still being fixed; planning acceptance was on hold.
zh: 规划功能当时仍在修复，规划验收暂未开放。

en: These notes for build 43 were added later.
Server work was tracked separately and did not prove successful planning.
That app update did not establish that the server was fixed.
zh: 这是构建 43 的补记说明。
在线服务进展单独记录，不代表规划已经通过。
不应把该次应用更新理解为服务端已经修复。
